name: feature-design-team-invite-approval
description: Design a team invite approval workflow for an existing B2B product and turn it into a concrete design memo.
prompt: Design the team invite approval feature described in brief.md and constraints.md. This is a feature-design request for an existing product, not a broad audit and not implementation. Do not ask follow-up questions. Compare at least two viable approaches, recommend one, and write the final design memo to artifacts/team-invite-approval-design.md. Leave brief.md and constraints.md unchanged.

expected.description: Writes the design memo into a deterministic artifact file.
Uses the documented feature-design memo structure.
Compares at least two viable approaches before choosing a direction.
Design accounts for approval state handling and the seat-billing constraint.
Includes auditability, expiry, and manual-override concerns from the brief.
Design mentions the related invite, admin, or mobile surfaces instead of treating the workflow as one isolated screen.

falsePositives.description: Should not rewrite the source brief while producing the design memo.
Should not rewrite the source constraints while producing the design memo.
Should not default to the feature-audit report structure.
